note: Memory levels for session pressure. Each anchor is a host shape measured from its own monitor history. A host between two anchors gets values interpolated on physical memory. Outside the anchors, MB values scale with memory and percent values stay at the nearest anchor. A host entry overrides single values for one host. A copy in the data directory (memory-levels.json) replaces this file. Calibration record: corpus/memory-levels-calibration-2026-11-17.md.

anchors.evidence: mac-48g (48 GiB, M4 Pro) 2026-11-17 04:10..10:25Z, 72 samples: free p5 68%, min 46%; swap 0 in every sample; claude tree RSS sum p50 13814 MB, p95 18294 MB, max 21746 MB at 90% free. Summed RSS double counts shared pages across about 1000 processes, so the RSS rungs only reach red or critical when the kernel free level agrees (50% or lower).
